context: OSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The dosage of Visken ® (pindolol) should be individualized. The recommended initial dose of Visken ® (pindolol) is 5 mg b.i.d. alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents. An antihypertensive response usually occurs within the first week of tre
nger than 2 weeks. If a satisfactory reduction in blood pressure does not occur within 3-4 weeks, the dose may be adjusted in increments of 10 mg/day at these intervals up to a maximum of 60 mg/day.
